- Responsible to define the qualification approach of product developments for power module products

This is you:

- PhD or master’s degree, preferably in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline
- Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar position, experienced in power module technology and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications, preferably in the SiC / GaN domain
- Knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High quality mindset
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Ability to work under pressure
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis (d/f/m): Virtual Sensor & State Estimation Development for Fuel Cell Systems (ZEROe) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our ZEROe team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Masterand student (d/f/m), title of thesis: Virtual Sensor & State Estimation Development for Fuel Cell Systems

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know about the development of virtual sensors and advanced state estimation techniques for fuel cell systems? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the ZEROe team as Masterand (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration: 6 months

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Conduct a comprehensive literature review on virtual sensing, state estimation, and model-based diagnostics for fuel cell systems.
- Develop and implement models for fuel cell system components relevant to virtual sensing (e.g., degradation, performance).
- Design and evaluate virtual sensor algorithms to infer unmeasured system states and parameters.
- Implement and validate state estimation techniques (e.g., Kalman filters, Extended Kalman Filters, particle filters) for fuel cell systems.
- Utilize simulation environments (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Python) for model development, algorithm testing, and data analysis.
- Analyze the performance and robustness of developed virtual sensors and state estimators under various operating conditions and fault scenarios.
- Document research findings, methodology, and results in a comprehensive Master's thesis.
- Present progress and results to the Airbus ZEROe team regularly.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time Master's student in the area of Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or a related field.
- Strong academic background in control theory, system identification, estimation theory, and data analysis.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python.
- Familiarity with fuel cell technologies and their operation principles is a plus.
- Experience with model-based development and simulation tools is desirable.
- Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and solve complex problems.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus.
- Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Research Officer (f/m/d) (Research-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
As part of the “Potenziale strategisch entfalten” initiative within zukunft.niedersachsen, a joint funding program of the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture and the Volkswagen Foundation, University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) is receiving almost €20 million to further strengthen its research and innovation activities. The UMG2032 – Excellence through Focus project focuses on recruiting and establishing early-career research groups, as well as early-career postdoctoral positions. Moreover, the project supports measures to promote knowledge transfer, graduate training for medical students, the establishment of a Medical Career Center, and further specialization in securing funding from international third-party funding agencies.

The Research Management team of the UMG oversees all EU-funded and international research projects, providing comprehensive support from advising applicants and handling contract negotiations to monitoring approved projects. Additionally, we assist with applications for national grants. As part of our commitment to expanding UMG’s success in securing international funding, we are placing a particular focus on opportunities from the US and UK. To achieve this, we are creating a specialized position within our team to provide targeted support to UMG scientists, covering both the application process and project administration.

We are seeking an open-minded, native English-speaking professional to step into this exciting and impactful role.

Your Tasks

Providing independent advice and support to researchers throughout the application and management process for third-party-funded research projects, with a particular emphasis on complex international funding opportunities. This includes navigating the specific regulatory and legal frameworks of international funding bodies, thereby enhancing our capacity to secure international grants. Key responsibilities include:

- Analysis and assessment of application and funding requirements, with a focus on understanding and interpreting the intricate regulatory and legal frameworks essential for successfully securing and implementing projects funded by international bodies.
- Providing guidance and support to researchers in the preparation, design, and drafting of third-party funding applications, ensuring compliance with the specific requirements of the funding call (e.g., budgetary considerations, formalities, and alignment of project proposals with the objectives of the call).
- Conducting formal and substantive reviews of third-party funding applications to ensure compliance with both internal and external guidelines, and coordinating additional administrative processes in collaboration with relevant UMG administrative departments.
- Providing support for ongoing internationally funded projects, including tasks such as contract negotiations and preparation, amendment requests, compliance monitoring, and financial or scientific reporting. Support for ongoing internationally projects (e.g. contract preparations, amendment requests, reporting)
- Offering target-group-specific information and organizing events or workshops on international research funding opportunities and best practices.
- Contributing to the strategic development of the Research Management Office, including identifying and addressing key challenges in handling complex international funding schemes and increasing UMG's competitiveness in securing international grants.

This role requires a deep understanding of the regulatory, legal and administrative landscape of international funders, with a focus on translating these complexities into actionable guidance and strategic opportunities for our researchers. By bridging the gap between funding bodies requirements and researchers needs, you will play a key role in expanding UMG’s potential to successfully acquire and manage international research grants.

To support your success in this role, we highly encourage further professional development, including certification as a Research Administrator (e.g., through the Research Administrators Certification Council), to deepen your expertise in international grant management and funding processes.

Your qualifications

- A completed academic degree (Master’s or equivalent)
- Experience in academic management or in the administration of third-party-funded collaborative projects is an advantage
- Strong knowledge of international funding landscape, particularly in the US or UK, ideally supported by certified further training (e.g. Certified Pre-Award Administrator (CPRA®) or Research   Admin (CPA®))
- Basic understanding of interdisciplinary topics relevant to grant applications, such as research data management, open science, diversity/equality and the promotion of early-career researchers
- Effective communication skills in German, written and spoken (minimum B1 level)
- A high level of initiative, organizational skills and reliability under time pressure, combined with strong teamwork and flexibility

We offer

- Good working conditions within a dedicated and motivated team
- A varied role in an international environment
- Health and fitness supported by an excellent workplace health management program
- A comprehensive range of training and development opportunities (see also above)
- Remuneration in accordance with the collective agreement for the public sector in the federal states (TV-L), including public sector social benefits and supplementary pension provision

Application deadline is Sunday, 18th October 2026 before the end of the day. Informal inquires can be directed to Dr. Uschi Hübner (forschung@med.uni-goettingen.de), Head of Research Management.

jobs.occupation: Director Real World Evidence Scientist (Oncology) (all genders) (Facharzt/-ärztin - Öffentliches Gesundheitswesen)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

This position can be filled either in Switzerland (Eysins) or Germany (Darmstadt) in a hybrid format.

Your role

Real-world evidence is reshaping how medicines are developed, approved, and valued — and in this role, you will be at the forefront of that transformation. As a Director Real-World Evidence Scientist in Oncology, you will own and drive the end-to-end RWE strategy for one or more complex, high-priority oncology programs, operating as a recognized scientific authority across the organization and beyond.

You will define and lead the integration of RWE into clinical development and regulatory strategies, working directly with global program teams and cross-functional partners across clinical, regulatory, market access, and commercial functions. You will design, initiate, and oversee non-interventional studies — from protocol development through to study reporting — and ensure the selection of fit-for-purpose real-world data sources that address critical research questions. Your scientific judgment will directly inform decision-making at the most senior levels of the organization.

Beyond program delivery, you will represent the organization in interactions with health authorities, contribute to peer-reviewed publications, and present at international conferences — actively shaping the external scientific landscape. You will also champion methodological innovation, drive process improvements, and serve as a scientific mentor to colleagues within the function, contributing to a culture of rigor, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Who you are

- You hold a Master’s degree or PhD in Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Biostatistics, or a related discipline, and bring 8 or more years of RWE experience gained in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract research organization setting.

- You are proficient in working with federated data networks and familiar with data standards such as OMOP CDM or FHIR, and bring strong methodological skills spanning epidemiology, pharmacology, and pharmacovigilance.
- You have a proven track record of leading RWE strategy at a global program level, navigating complex, matrixed organizations and collaborating effectively across clinical development, regulatory affairs, and market access functions.
- You bring experience in regulatory and/or payer submissions and interactions, and a thorough understanding of the evolving regulatory environment for RWE.
- You communicate with clarity and confidence — translating complex scientific content for diverse audiences, including senior leadership and external stakeholders — and you are fluent in English.
- Ideally, you also bring experience with AI/ML applications in RWE (including NLP), patient-reported outcomes (PRO), health technology assessment, and a track record of thought leadership through publications, conference presentations, or advisory roles.

jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Postdoctoral researcher for X‑ray microscopy at atomic resolution

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FSPO009/2026 | Deadline: 20.10.2026 |

Full-time/Part-time

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Advanced Multilayer X‑ray Optics group at CFEL is one of the leading research groups developing novel X‑ray lenses, also known as multilayer Laue lenses (MLLs). We plan to further improve and extend MLLs as part of a large project to image, understand and ultimately control electron dynamics in molecular systems. To do this, we are combining concepts from X-ray microscopy, crystallography, and ultrafast X‑ray science. Here is an opportunity for a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to be part of our team and this exciting project.

About your role:

- Prepare and conduct scientific experiments at various X‑ray facilities (synchrotrons and XFELs)
- Develop and apply techniques to characterize and improve X‑ray lenses (MLLs) and gratings
- Extend and improve X‑ray imaging modalities towards atomic resolution
- Explore the feasibility of MLLs for various experiments and for their increased use at lab, synchrotron and XFEL sources
- Communicate findings via publications and presentations

About you:

- PhD in physics, applied physics or a related field
- Sound knowledge of Fourier optics, X-ray physics, and metrology
- Experience in experimental methods or development of instrumentation
- Experience with synchrotron and XFEL experiments is an advantage
- Good programming skills, especially in Python
- Proficient in English and in writing scientific articles
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
- High self-motivation and ability to work in an interdisciplinary team

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours and variable part-time. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Dr. Saša Bajt at +49 40 8998‑2082 (https://tel:+494089982082) , sasa.bajt@desy.de (sasa.bajt@desy.de)

jobs.description:
About us NET CHECK GmbH was founded in 1999 with the aim of improving the quality of communication networks. Since then, NET CHECK has developed into the leading partner of network operators and infrastructure providers of mobile and fixed networks of all technologies. Its core competencies include international network benchmarking (comparative measurements) as well as network planning and fault analysis. NET CHECK has one of Germany's largest crowdsourcing platforms, which generates over 144 million data points every day. Our commitment to quality and security has earned us the trust of scientific and government institutions.
NET CHECK is headquartered in Berlin and is part of the NC GROUP, an owner-managed group of companies with a total of over 180 employees at five locations in Germany and one in Belgrade, Serbia.

Job Summary: We are seeking a Senior Microelectronics Engineer for Embedded Systems to join our hardware R&D team. The successful candidate will play a key role in the design, development and validation of electronics and embedded solutions for telecommunication measurement systems. This position involves leading the design of microelectronic circuits, developing embedded firmware and ensuring the integration across hardware and software components.
Responsibilities
• Design and develop microelectronic circuits for telecom measurement equipment.
• Develop and optimize embedded firmware for STM32 microcontrollers using C/C++, with expertise in UART, Ethernet, and USB communication interfaces.
• Perform schematic design, prototyping and laboratory testing to ensure product reliability and compliance with telecom industry standards.
• Lead design reviews and drive design improvements across hardware and firmware domains.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, software and mechanical) to integrate hardware designs into system architecture.
• Research and evaluate latest microelectronics and embedded technologies relevant to telecom measurement systems.
• Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including design specifications, verification procedures and detailed engineering reports.
• Provide technical guidance to junior engineers while contributing to continuous improvement initiative within the hardware R&D team.

Your profile
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in microelectronics and embedded system design.
• Proven expertise in embedded firmware development using C/C++ on STM32 or similar ARM-based microcontrollers.
• Hands-on experience with communication interfaces such as UART, Ethernet and USB.
• Solid knowledge in circuit design, PCB layout design and hardware debugging.
• Proficiency with electronic design in CAD tools (e.g. KiCAD, Eagle).
• Familiarity with RF systems, telecom interfaces (e.g., LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi), and signal processing is a strong plus.
• Experience in laboratory testing, prototyping and performance optimization of embedded systems.
• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken), German is a plus.

We Offer
• Employment Type: Full-Time, indefinite term.
• A dynamic team characterized by creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence, creating an innovative workplace.
• Flexible working hours.
• 28 vacation days.
• Health & Sports Subsidy: Sports membership subsidy.
• Public Transportation Subsidy: Monthly subsidy for a Germany-wide ticket.
• Bicycle leasing via JobRad.
• Regular Team Events.

jobs.occupation: Marine Operations & QCM Specialist – Vessel Operations, Quality Control & Claims (m/f/d) (Schifffahrtskaufmann/-frau - Linienfahrt)
jobs.description:
About us

We are the European general agency of the globally active shipping company KAWASAKI KISEN KAISHA Ltd. ("K" Line). As a leading shipping company in the RoRo business, we offer highly sophisti­cated and tailor-made mari­time trans­port solu­tions to our custo­mers from the automotive and heavy machinery indus­tries. As European headquarters based in Hamburg, we are respon­sible for plan­ning and managing the regular services from Europe to North America and Asia as well as their marke­ting in Europe.

Your responsibilities

- Support technical assessment and acceptance of cargoes incl. High & Heavy, special and project cargo as well as review of operational handling
- Support IMDG-related coordination, including documentation review, DG stowage information and operational communication with vessels and ports.
- Participate in cargo quality follow-up, damage prevention, port attendance, vessel feedback and survey-related matters.
- Support QCM/VOS team with analysis of operational deviations, near misses, cargo damage cases and root-cause identification incl. standardization of workflows, SOPs, checklists and digital tools.
- Assist with claims handling by reviewing damage documentation, survey reports, incident reports and operational evidence.
- Prepare and issue voyage instructions, discharging instructions, sailing information and operational updates in internal systems.
- Communicate with vessels, ship management companies, local offices, ports, agents and internal departments to maintain scheduled voyages.
- Support bunkering coordination, including confirmation of fuel specifications and review of bunker supplier information.
- Prepare, review and distribute cargo stowage plans to relevant parties.
- Collect and follow up operational cost reports from local offices.
- Assist with environmental and technical matters related to vessel operations.
- Support operational follow-up in case of disruption, delay, off-hire or other vessel-related incidents.
- Prepare summaries, meeting materials, reports incl. incident reports in case of accidents, serious cargo damage or operational irregularities and coordinate required follow-up actions.

Your profile

- Completed vocational training, university degree or comparable qualification related to shipping, logistics, nautical science, marine operations or port operations.
- Nautical background, sea-going experience, port captain experience or marine technical experience is an advantage.
- Professional experience in RoRo shipping, vessel operations, port logistics, cargo planning, High & Heavy, survey or claims handling is desirable.
- Good understanding of vessel operations, port processes, cargo flow, stowage planning and international communication chains.
- Knowledge of the IMO CSS Code, IMDG Code and SOLAS is an advantage.
- Very good written and spoken English; German language skills are expressly preferred.
- Careful working style, strong affinity for numbers, good prioritization skills and a sense of responsibility in critical situations.
- Willingness to travel to European ports, terminals, vessels and service providers as well as a Class B driving license.

Digital competencies

- Confident use of Microsoft 365, especially Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint.
- Experience working with structured data, operational reports, Excel analyses and management documents.
- Openness towards digital collaboration tools such as SharePoint Lists, Planner, Loop or comparable solutions.
- Basic understanding and responsible use of modern AI models and AI-supported applications in the daily work context.

We offer:

- Permanent full-time position in an international maritime environment
- Cross-departmental role between Vessel Operations and Quality Control & Marine Technical with a diverse range of responsibilities
- Close collaboration with international colleagues, ports, vessels, OEMs, surveyors, and ship management teams worldwide
- Great intercultural corporate culture with the opportunity to work across global networks
- Attractive remuneration package, including additional benefits such as vacation pay and a 13th monthly salary
- Additional allowances for the Deutschlandticket, fitness center, Ticket Plus® City, and more
- Capital-forming benefits (Vermögenswirksame Leistungen)
- Flexible working hours and attractive mobile working options to support a positive work-life balance
- Modern office conveniently located near a central HVV hub in Hamburg

If you would like to join our team, please send your application in English (application letter, curriculum vitae, references), stating your salary expectations and the earliest possible date of entry, to jobs@de.kline.com (https://mailto:jobs@de.kline.com?subject=Application%20as%20Team%20Member%20(m%2Ff%2Fd)%20Vessel%20Operations) .
